"""
stress_test.py -- stress-test the optimal plan of model_v2 under
perturbed data: capacities (RHS) and profit coefficients (objective).

For each scenario:
  - re-solve exactly (vertex enumeration, generalized to any b1,b2,cA,cB)
  - cross-check with a dense grid scan (independent method)
  - compare against analytic predictions (shadow prices / optimality ranges)
  - report whether the ORIGINAL plan (42,16) stays feasible / optimal
"""

from itertools import combinations

TOL = 1e-9
X_OLD, Z_OLD = (42.0, 16.0), 2480.0

def solve(b1, b2, cA, cB):
    cons = [((2.0, 1.0), float(b1), "machine"),
            ((1.0, 3.0), float(b2), "labor"),
            ((-1.0, 0.0), 0.0, "xA>=0"),
            ((0.0, -1.0), 0.0, "xB>=0")]
    verts = []
    for (a1, r1, n1), (a2, r2, n2) in combinations(cons, 2):
        det = a1[0]*a2[1] - a1[1]*a2[0]
        if abs(det) < TOL:
            continue
        x = ((r1*a2[1] - a1[1]*r2)/det, (a1[0]*r2 - r1*a2[0])/det)
        # feasibility against ALL constraints, not just the intersected pair
        if all(ai[0]*x[0] + ai[1]*x[1] <= ri + TOL for ai, ri, _ in cons):
            x = (max(0.0, x[0]), max(0.0, x[1]))
            if not any(abs(x[0]-v[0][0]) < 1e-7 and abs(x[1]-v[0][1]) < 1e-7
                       for v in verts):
                verts.append((x, n1, n2))
    scored = sorted((cA*x[0] + cB*x[1], x, f"{n1}&{n2}") for x, n1, n2 in verts)
    zbest = max(s[0] for s in scored)
    opt = [(x, act) for z, x, act in scored if abs(z - zbest) <= 1e-7*max(1.0, abs(zbest))]
    return zbest, opt

def grid_check(b1, b2, cA, cB):
    """Independent cross-check on the 0.1 lattice over [0,60] x [0,40]."""
    best, at_best = -1.0, 0
    for i in range(601):
        xa = i * 0.1
        for j in range(401):
            xb = j * 0.1
            if 2*xa + xb <= b1 + TOL and xa + 3*xb <= b2 + TOL:
                z = cA*xa + cB*xb
                if z > best + TOL:
                    best, at_best = z, 1
                elif abs(z - best) <= TOL:
                    at_best += 1
    return best, at_best

def old_plan_status(b1, b2, cA, cB, z_new):
    feas = (2*X_OLD[0] + X_OLD[1] <= b1 + TOL and X_OLD[0] + 3*X_OLD[1] <= b2 + TOL)
    z_old_newc = cA*X_OLD[0] + cB*X_OLD[1]
    return feas, z_old_newc, z_new - z_old_newc

SCENARIOS = [
    # name                     b1   b2   cA   cB
    ("BASE",                  100,  90,  40,  50),
    ("machine +10%",          110,  90,  40,  50),
    ("machine -10%",           90,  90,  40,  50),
    ("labor +10%",            100,  99,  40,  50),
    ("labor -10%",            100,  81,  40,  50),
    ("both cap +10%",         110,  99,  40,  50),
    ("profit A +10%",         100,  90,  44,  50),
    ("profit A -10%",         100,  90,  36,  50),
    ("profit B +10%",         100,  90,  40,  55),
    ("profit B -10%",         100,  90,  40,  45),
    ("cA at range edge 100",  100,  90, 100,  50),
    ("cA beyond range 120",   100,  90, 120,  50),
    ("cB beyond range 125",   100,  90,  40, 125),
    ("machine -80% (20h)",     20,  90,  40,  50),
    ("cA+10% AND mach+10%",   110,  90,  44,  50),
]

hdr = (f"{'scenario':22s} {'new optimum (xA,xB)':>20s} {'Z*':>8s} "
       f"{'grid ok':>7s} {'old plan':>24s}")
print(hdr)
print("-" * len(hdr))

for name, b1, b2, cA, cB in SCENARIOS:
    z, opt = solve(b1, b2, cA, cB)
    zg, nb = grid_check(b1, b2, cA, cB)
    ok = abs(zg - z) <= 1e-6
    feas, z_old_c, gap = old_plan_status(b1, b2, cA, cB, z)
    pts = " & ".join(f"({x[0]:g},{x[1]:g})" for x, _ in opt)
    acts = {a for _, a in opt}
    tag = f"{pts} [{'; '.join(sorted(acts))}]"
    old = (f"feas, Z={z_old_c:g}, -{gap:g}" if feas and gap > TOL else
           f"feas & OPTIMAL" if feas else
           f"INFEASIBLE (needs 100>{b1:g} mach)" if b1 < 100 else "feas, Z=?")
    if not feas:
        old = "INFEASIBLE -> must re-plan"
    print(f"{name:22s} {tag:>20s} {z:8g} {str(ok):>7s} {old:>24s}"
          + ("" if nb == 1 or len(opt) > 1 else "  !!"))

print()
print("=" * 74)
print("ANALYTIC CROSS-CHECKS")
print("=" * 74)
print("Shadow prices y=(14,12): for RHS in basis range, Z* = 14*b1 + 12*b2")
for name, b1, b2 in [("machine +10%", 110, 90), ("machine -10%", 90, 90),
                     ("labor +10%", 100, 99), ("labor -10%", 100, 81),
                     ("both cap +10%", 110, 99)]:
    pred = 14*b1 + 12*b2
    z, _ = solve(b1, b2, 40, 50)
    print(f"  {name:14s}: predicted {pred:7.1f}  actual {z:7.1f}  match={abs(pred-z)<1e-6}")

print()
print("Profit ranges keeping vertex (42,16) optimal (cone condition):")
print("  cA in [cB/3, 2*cB] ; cB in [cA/2, 3*cA]")
print(f"  with cB=50: cA in [{50/3:.2f}, 100]  -> +10% (44) and -10% (36) inside: "
      f"{50/3 <= 36 and 44 <= 100}")
print(f"  with cA=40: cB in [20, 120]  -> +10% (55) and -10% (45) inside: "
      f"{20 <= 45 and 55 <= 120}")
print("  profit-ratio robustness: plan optimal iff cA/cB in [1/3, 2]; base ratio 0.8")
print("  -> cA must FALL ~58% or RISE 150% before the plan itself changes")
